title: Project text files
summary: Read, list and atomically replace bounded UTF-8 files within a canonical Project root. Runtime records and symlink components are not exposed.

replaceability.why: Holds Project integrity or trusted execution authority; replacing it requires Lumeri control.

reach.notes: Trusted Runtime seam, not an additional grant to a creator Luc.

operations.name: read_text
operations.notes: No operation deadline is enforced at this seam.

operations.name: list_directory
operations.notes: No operation deadline is enforced at this seam.

operations.name: write_text
operations.notes: No operation deadline is enforced at this seam. Returns UTF-8 byte count. One file is replaced atomically with fsync; parent directories can also be created. Append retries duplicate text. This primitive does not advance Project revision or record client_op_id, so it cannot provide a replaceable atomic governed write alone.

invariants.text: Generic file access cannot read, list or replace Runtime records, including case variants and temporary replacements.
UTF-8 input and output are capped at 4194304 bytes.

break: An unhandled exception, invalid output, or failed declared artifact check.
failure.notes: The original reports failure today. The self-Luc run gate and original fallback are requirements for a future replacement, not a promise this seam already implements.

conformance.notes: Contract schema checking is available; replacement conformance is not wired at this seam.

known_deviations.text: Single-file replacement is atomic, but file bytes, Project revision, and durable execution result are not committed together by this primitive.
